instruction: Candid action photograph, medium shot from a low angle. Outdoors on a concrete ledge under a blue sky with fluffy clouds, the man in a black t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) lies on his back, legs extended upward. He supports the woman in a black crop top and denim shorts (R1) on his feet at her hips. The woman (R1) balances horizontally in the air, wearing black socks, with her arms swept back. The man's (R2) arms rest flat on the ledge. Bright natural sunlight illuminates the scene.
